summary: All sections present; 170/170 citations resolve in-range; 1 major semantic defect (RL2 draw-stack behavior) + 3 minor citation/wording fixes.

defects.claim: If the drawn tile cannot be placed anywhere, a new tile is drawn (the unplaceable one is left in the reshuffled stack)
defects.problem: The code discards unplaceable tiles from the draw stack (getPlayableTileFromDrawstack recurses on rest, dropping the head); a dropped tile can never be placed.
defects.evidence: src/Helpers/FrontendHelpers.elm:132-143 getPlayableTileFromDrawstack; src/Backend.elm:53 and :69 assign the returned stack directly
defects.fix_instruction: Replace the parenthetical with '(unplaceable tiles are skipped and silently dropped from the draw stack — they are never re-inserted and can never be placed)'; optionally add a Section 10 note on this divergence from readme.md:59.

defects.problem: elm.json:12-15 lists elm/html, elm/random, elm/url, random-extra — not Lamdera; the Lamdera deps are at lines 17-18.
elm.json:13-14 are elm/random and elm/url — support nothing about Evergreen/Lamdera serialization.
defects.fix_instruction: Drop `elm.json:13-14` from this item; keep only `src/Evergreen/Migrate/V10.elm:3-18` (still UNVERIFIED).

defects.location: Section 7 Domain Events table, PlayerRegistered row (artifact line 291)
defects.claim: also re-broadcast to every client on each lobby change and on new connections
defects.problem: PlayerRegistrationUpdated is sent on new connections, accepted registration (broadcast) and duplicate rejection — NOT on kick or kill (those broadcast PlayerKicked/LobbyKilled).
defects.fix_instruction: Reword to: '(re-sent to the registering client on new connections and duplicate-name rejection, and broadcast to all clients when another player registers)'.
